FN-V77YAVV-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 222
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/05/2025
Senate Bill 222 as reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic
Development would not affect state funding. The bill would provide that the state give assent to
the readjustment of municipal indebtedness of certain medical clinic boards.
